themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to public services, housing, and welfare. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, and France, where parties like Vox, Lega, and Rassemblement National are advocating for stricter immigration controls and preferential treatment for nationals.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands 'national priority' in healthcare and housing, arguing that immigrants should not receive the same benefits as Spanish citizens.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega pushes for policies that prioritize Italian citizens in welfare and public services, aligning with broader nationalist rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen advocates for stricter immigration policies and national priority in social benefits, reinforcing the party's anti-immigration stance.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox (Andalusia)
countries.note: Vox in Andalusia pushes for 'national priority' in regional policies, demanding that public resources be reserved for Spanish citizens.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's policies and political maneuvers continue to dominate right-wing and far-right media narratives worldwide. From immigration reforms to economic strategies, Trump's influence is evident in the U.S., Poland, Argentina, and the UK, where his policies are either emulated or criticized by local right-wing factions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's immigration policies, such as restricting green card applications, are central to his administration's agenda and receive extensive coverage.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Poland's PiS party aligns with Trump's nationalist policies, particularly in defense and immigration, and highlights U.S.-Poland military cooperation.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government in Argentina frequently references Trump's economic policies, particularly deregulation and tax cuts, as a model for reform.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK echoes Trump's anti-immigration rhetoric, advocating for stricter border controls and reduced migration.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are gaining traction in polls, reflecting a broader shift toward nationalist and anti-establishment politics. This trend is particularly strong in Germany, Sweden, France, and Norway, where parties like AfD, Sverigedemokraterna, and Rassemblement National are either leading or making significant electoral gains.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in several German states, capitalizing on anti-immigration and anti-EU sentiment.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sverigedemokraterna maintains strong polling numbers, focusing on immigration and law-and-order policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party is leading in French polls, positioning itself as the main opposition to Macron's government.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Fremskrittspartiet leads Norwegian polls, advocating for stricter immigration policies and tax cuts.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in multiple countries are grappling with internal divisions, often centered around leadership disputes, policy disagreements, or personal rivalries. These divisions are evident in Poland, Hungary, Argentina, and Italy, where factions within parties like PiS, Fidesz, La Libertad Avanza, and Lega are openly clashing.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal strife over leadership and policy direction, particularly regarding relations with the U.S. and EU.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz and the Tisza Party are locked in a power struggle, with accusations of corruption and authoritarianism dividing the right.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government is plagued by infighting, particularly between factions led by Karina Milei and Patricia Bullrich.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces internal divisions over its alliance with Fratelli d'Italia, with Salvini struggling to maintain party unity.

themes.title: Far-right governments target universities and education
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right governments are increasingly targeting universities and education systems, either through funding cuts, ideological control, or attacks on academic freedom. This trend is visible in Hungary, the U.S., Argentina, and Germany, where governments are reshaping educational institutions to align with their political agendas.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The Hungarian government under Viktor Orbán has centralized control over universities, limiting academic freedom and cutting funding for liberal institutions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration has proposed significant cuts to education funding and pushed for ideological control over curricula.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government has proposed sweeping reforms to Argentina's education system, including privatization and deregulation.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD advocates for homeschooling and reduced state control over education, challenging Germany's traditional school system.
